name: Medical Center
description: Medical Center is a medical drama series which aired on CBS from 1969 to 1976. It was produced by MGM Television.

videos.title: The Last 10 Yards
videos.overview: Bru Wiley, a college football star up for Heisman honors and a top pro career, ignores his failing health.

videos.title: Victim
videos.overview: Although the father of a 7-year-old with severe internal injuries insists the child fell off an embankment, Dr. Gannon  suspects the child was beaten.

videos.title: Emergency in Ward E
videos.overview: Focuses on the psychological interplay between two patients in serious shape.

videos.title: A Life is Waiting
videos.overview: The question of a therapeutic abortion divides Nora Caldwell (Barbara Rush) and her husband Dan (John McMartin).

videos.title: The Battle of Lily Wu
videos.overview: A Vietnamese war victim (France Nuyen) is being treated at the medical center.

videos.title: The Crooked Circle
videos.overview: A story about drug addiction.

videos.title: Thousands and Thousands of Miles
videos.overview: Jenny Webb (Brooke Bundy), with a hemorrhaging kidney and a baby on the way, is rejected by her angry father and uncaring boyfriend.

videos.title: The Sharpest Edge
videos.overview: An intradepartmental dispute pits Gannon against the new acting chief of surgery (John Marley).

videos.title: Jeopardy
videos.overview: Dr. Gannon tries to prove that the suddenly violent behavior of student Greg Soreson stems from an organic ailment.

videos.title: The Fallen Image
videos.overview: A U.S. ambassador (Walter Pidgeon) has a heart condition that could jeopardize a crucial meeting.

videos.title: The Loner
videos.overview: A patient (Lee Grant) learns a lesson about life from a little boy (Fabian Gregory).

videos.title: 24 Hours
videos.overview: Gannon stakes his reputation on the integrity of a student nurse (Belinda Montgomery).

videos.title: The Adversaries
videos.overview: Interns Steve Seagren and Katherine Kenter are both being considered for a much-prized residency.

videos.title: The Deceived
videos.overview: A student facing kidney failure gets no comfort from her alienated family or her disinterested ex-husband.

videos.title: Moment of Decision
videos.overview: Dr. Lochner's emotions conflict with his professional judgment when he faces a crisis concerning his own daughter.

videos.title: Runaway
videos.overview: Dr. Gannon tries to bridge a gap between a 17-year-old and his gruff immigrant father.

videos.title: Fright and Flight
videos.overview: A blind student's recovery depends on recalling the horrible event that caused her loss of sight.

videos.title: A Duel with Doom
videos.overview: The director of a foundation for teenage parolees lays his life on the line to save one of his charges.

videos.title: A Matter of Tomorrow
videos.overview: The story of a dedicated head nurse (Mercedes McCambridge).

videos.title: Care is no Cure
videos.overview: A sensitive story about Gannon's love for an incurably ill woman (Shelby Grant).

videos.title: The Professional
videos.overview: A former gridiron idol (Forrest Tucker) finds living with his own legend unbearable.

videos.title: The Combatants
videos.overview: A research specialist (William Shatner) clashes with Gannon over a possible cancer cure.

videos.title: The V.D. Story
videos.overview: A story about the need to treat venereal disease as a medical problem divorced from social stigma.

videos.title: His Brother's Keeper
videos.overview: Dr. Martin Lambert is blind to the fact that his older son suffers from a muscular disorder and that he has neglected his younger son.

videos.title: The Rebel in White
videos.overview: An ambitious black resident (Georg Stanford Brown) is convinced that Gannon is preventing him from performing surgery.

videos.title: Between Dark And Daylight
videos.overview: The story of a marriage tormented by lack of children.

videos.title: Brink of Doom
videos.overview: A surgeon's (George Grizzard) career may be ended by multiple sclerosis.

videos.title: Undercurrent
videos.overview: A dedicated research scientist's vital work on a new drug is threatened when anonymous letters accuse him of being a homosexual.

videos.title: Junkie
videos.overview: A story about the feelings of parents whose teenagers are drug addicts. Gannon tries to save a 16-year-old girl from heroin addiction. His efforts are continually frustrated by her father, a professor who refuses to acknowledge the problem.

videos.title: Assailant
videos.overview: A brooding young doctor (Gary Lockwood) is suspected of murdering a woman on hospital grounds.

videos.title: The Clash
videos.overview: A woman doctor (Vera Miles) battles male prejudice.

videos.title: Ghetto Clinic
videos.overview: William Devane guests as the maverick director of a free clinic. The maverick director of a ghetto clinic endangers its future by his refusal to follow rules in making reports on his patients to the police.

videos.title: Scream of Silence
videos.overview: The problems of parents with mentally disabled children are explored in this episode. Dr. Gannon recommends treatment for Jenny, an abnormally active little girl. What do you do with a gifted child? Doc Gannon believes in a school for exceptional youngsters, and since he is the godfather of the child, he pushes a bit. Gannon's adversary is Mom, who takes an opposing position, and the friction between the two sparks the hour.

videos.title: Death Grip
videos.overview: The problems of a doctor who has trouble adjusting to civilian life after serving in Vietnam. Dr. Eric Canford, a brilliant surgeon, comes back from war service with a drinking problem but refuses to admit it is affecting his work.

videos.title: Witch Hunt
videos.overview: Modern medicine clashes with black magic as Gannon tries to save a girl afflicted with Addison's Disease-and a belief in the all-pervading, healing powers of Satan. (60 mins)

videos.title: Deadly Encounter
videos.overview: The problems of a patient who may face radical surgery. Doc Gannon demonstrates his noble side for the ladies, protecting Sandra Polk, a patient, when her husband becomes jealous. Suspicious professor Tink Polk flares up over his wife's appointments with Gannon while Joe, of course, remains Simon pure, merely keeping his patient's illness from her husband at her request.

videos.title: Trial by Terror
videos.overview: Blinded in an attack, Gannon is still being stalked by a would-be killer.

videos.title: Accused
videos.overview: A hallucinating patient accuses Gannon of fathering her unborn child.

videos.title: Crisis
videos.overview: Gannon is accused of shielding a seriously injured cop who allegedly shot a student without provocation.

videos.title: Man at Bay
videos.overview: A brash, long-haired surgeon (Gary Lockwood) runs afoul of his colleagues.

videos.title: The Savage Image
videos.overview: Gannon tries to save the life of a seriously ill Indian chief and enroll the chief's son in a physician's-assistant training program.

videos.title: Woman in Question
videos.overview: An intern who thinks his fiancee is ""wholesome"" doesn't know she contracted syphilis before they met.

videos.title: Web of Darkness
videos.overview: A deadly story of sibling conflict.

videos.title: Danger Point
videos.overview: A missing radium implant could contaminate the entire hospital.

videos.title: Secret Heritage
videos.overview: A mentally disabled teenager (Pamela Franklin) has been abandoned by her mother.

videos.title: Edge of Violence
videos.overview: The story of a troubled former vaudeville star (Jack Carter).

videos.title: Countdown
videos.overview: The high cost of hospital care is dramatized.

videos.title: Perfection of Vices
videos.overview: An insight into Lochner's personal life with his ex-wife (Dina Merrill) and daughter (Charlotte Stewart).

videos.title: The Man in Hiding
videos.overview: A once-brilliant surgeon (Richard Kiley) has become totally withdrawn. Dr—Thomas Patton, once a brilliant surgeon, now specializes in pathology, where he works only with the dead. Nor can anything reawaken his interest in the living, not even the needs of his critically ill ex-wife.

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: An aging doctor mistakenly believes that his medical practice is as good as ever. Pat Hingle as Dr. Farrring, a septuagenarian heart-transplant recipient whose mistaken faith in his new-found stamina could have tragic consequences for a young cancer patient.

videos.title: Blood Line
videos.overview: A fugitive (William Windom) is torn between freedom and love for his anemic son.

videos.title: The Corrupted
videos.overview: A character study of an ambitious surgeon (Steve Lawrence).

videos.title: The Imposter
videos.overview: A highly respected country doctor's (Forrest Tucker) long career as a bogus physician is about to be exposed.

videos.title: Double Jeopardy
videos.overview: Artificial insemination plays a part in the story of a heart patient who risks her life to protect her sterile husband's pride.

videos.title: Idolmaker
videos.overview: Character studies of two critically ill patients who are jeopardizing their lives.

videos.title: Circle of Power
videos.overview: A distinguished surgeon (Barry Sullivan) is losing the use of his hands.

videos.title: The Shattered Man
videos.overview: A troubled husband (Bradford Dillman) is being treated for psychological impotence.

videos.title: The Albatross
videos.overview: A drama about mental retardation.

videos.title: Martyr
videos.overview: An iron-willed lady (Jo Van Fleet) is determined to spend her life in a wheelchair.

videos.title: Suspected
videos.overview: A surgeon's (Earl Hilliman) past comes back to haunt him: the once-convicted sex offender is now charged with child molesting.

videos.title: The Loser
videos.overview: A student nurse (Susan Strasberg) is plagued by a bad marriage and a mysterious respiratory illness.

videos.title: The Pawn
videos.overview: Medical quackery is the target of a drama in which a charming fraud (George Maharis) is risking the life of a young patient.

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: A lung-cancer victim (Suzanne Pleshette) is determined to keep her nightmare a secret.

videos.title: The Nowhere Child
videos.overview: An 11-year-old orphan's chance for adoption is threatened by a mysterious illness.

videos.title: Shock! (1)
videos.overview: Change-of-pace suspense drama about Gannon's involvement with an ailing tycoon and his conflict-ridden household. First of two parts.

videos.title: Shock! (2)
videos.overview: Dr. Lochner's sister is the prime suspect in the conclusion of a murder story.

videos.title: Fatal Decision
videos.overview: Gannon's romance with a woman doctor is plagued by a secret past.

videos.title: Terror
videos.overview: Bubonic plague is the villain in a medical conflict over the unidentified victim.

videos.title: Secret
videos.overview: A doctor (Michael Callan) is driven back to alcoholism by the fear of losing his dying wife.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: A doctor (Monte Markham) is torn between a career in hospital administration and a return to surgical practice.

videos.title: Deadlock
videos.overview: A surgeon is offered a grim choice: his kidnapped wife will be saved if he can arrange the death of a certain patient.

videos.title: Awakening
videos.overview: A car-crash victim (Craig Stevens) awakes from a three-year coma to a nightmare: the crash killed his daughter and left him with an unforgiving wife.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: A woman (Ida Lupino) mysteriously turns against Gannon after he saves her husband's life.

videos.title: Conflict
videos.overview: A rape-murder mystery takes a grim twist with a confession by a young intern's fiance.

videos.title: Vision of Doom
videos.overview: A doctor (William Windom) has a premonition that his wife will die in surgery.

videos.title: Cycle of Peril
videos.overview: A woman refuses an emergency operation for fear it will endanger her pregnancy.

videos.title: Condemned
videos.overview: The story of a growing attachment between an injured teenager and his critically ill roommate.

videos.title: Wall of Silence
videos.overview: A drama about deafness and family strife.

videos.title: The Torn Man
videos.overview: Tragedy for a 42-year-old intern: he's fallen in love with a critically ill patient.

videos.title: Betrayed
videos.overview: A hospital volunteer (Geraldine Page) has a horrifying secret.

videos.title: Doctor and Mr. Harper
videos.overview: A drama about an unemployed man married to a doctor.

videos.title: The Fallen
videos.overview: The ugly-duckling story is no fairy tale to a patient who thinks she's so second-rate that she wants to die.

videos.title: Tico Taco, M.D.
videos.overview: Superstition vs. science as a critically ill woman refuses medical help.

videos.title: The Outcast
videos.overview: A brilliant researcher is taking great pains to conceal his past.

videos.title: No Sanctuary
videos.overview: A nun has secrets that are hindering her recovery from a beating and rape.

videos.title: Gladiator
videos.overview: Problems for a college football hero include a drug habit, a serious illness and a disabled wife.

videos.title: No Way Out
videos.overview: A doctor's puzzling spells of fatigue are hampering her work.

videos.title: A Game for One Player
videos.overview: A tortured relationship evolves between a lonely widow and the doctor who blames himself for her husband's death.

videos.title: Pressure Point
videos.overview: The success of a new surgical procedure is threatened by the surgeon's worry over his wife's erratic behavior.

videos.title: Question of Guilt
videos.overview: A woman convict's bitterness is threatening her success in a medical training program.

videos.title: Judgement
videos.overview: The story of a desperately lonely hospital volunteer (Ruth Buzzi).

videos.title: End of the Line
videos.overview: A high-wire performer's illness might kill her if she continues her career.

videos.title: Between Two Fires
videos.overview: A surgeon's new procedure might save his dying wife, if he can conquer his drug addiction in time to operate.

videos.title: Night Cry
videos.overview: Drama about the future of an illegitimate child whose father has been critically injured.

videos.title: No Margin for Error
videos.overview: A famous doctor's (Celeste Holm) own vital surgery must be delayed to help a man with a live bomb lodged in his chest.

videos.title: Impact
videos.overview: An ailing boy's divorced parents can't agree whether to permit surgery.

videos.title: Fatal Memory
videos.overview: A woman (Stefanie Powers) refuses to admit symptoms of a serious illness.

videos.title: Vortex
videos.overview: Dr. Lochner's one-time fiancee has a beautiful daughter who's gravely ill.

videos.title: The Guilty
videos.overview: A young woman is stricken with hysterical paralysis after seeing her mother with a lover.

videos.title: Time of Darkness
videos.overview: An emergency call to a mountain community leads Gannon to a patient guarded by mysterious, gun-toting townsfolk.

videos.title: Broken Image
videos.overview: Bent on proving his virility, an aging surgeon becomes involved with a young patient.

videos.title: Impasse
videos.overview: A lesbian psychiatrist is plagued by prejudice against her life style.

videos.title: Clash of Shadows
videos.overview: The horror of crib death is explored in this story about a couple who lose their 4-month-old child.

videos.title: The Casualty
videos.overview: Romance ends for Gannon when his girlfriend's husband, missing for six years in Vietnam, comes home to reclaim his wife and son.

videos.title: Stranger in Two Worlds
videos.overview: A champion diver is ignoring an illness that could end her career.

videos.title: Child of Violence
videos.overview: A wounded child from war-torn Northern Ireland baffles Gannon by showing no desire to get well.

videos.title: Woman for Hire
videos.overview: An idealistic young resident falls in love with an ailing prostitute.

videos.title: A Life at Stake
videos.overview: Compulsive gambling is ruining the life of a once-fine surgeon.

videos.title: Nightmare
videos.overview: Gannon is receiving bloodcurdling murder threats that contain only one clue: the would-be killer is someone on the hospital staff.

videos.title: Deadly Game
videos.overview: A derelict fakes her way into the hospital for free room and board, unaware that she is suffering from a serious disease.

videos.title: Web of Intrigue
videos.overview: An arrogant young resident refuses to submit to authority.

videos.title: Trial by Knife
videos.overview: Sparks fly when Gannon and the newly-appointed chief of surgery begin to clash on medical opinions.

videos.title: Choice of Evils
videos.overview: A proud man must decide whether to live with a dangerous illness, or submit to surgery which might cause impotence.

videos.title: No Escape
videos.overview: Gannon's patient needs a kidney transplant, and her only hope of a compatible donor is her father â€” a convict who is serving time for murder.

videos.title: Dark Warning
videos.overview: A seriously ill surgeon tries to hide his condition long enough to perform lifesaving surgery on his ex-wife.

videos.title: Girl from Bedlam
videos.overview: While investigating conditions in a mental hospital, Gannon falls in love with an amnesiac whose blinding headaches have gone untreated by the staff.

videos.title: Spectre
videos.overview: Determined to save a critically ill patient, a surgeon is hiding his own serious malady from his colleagues.

videos.title: The Enemies
videos.overview: A young genius becomes the center of a custody battle between his critically ill mother and a wealthy, would-be benefactress.

videos.title: The Conspirators
videos.overview: An accused rapist may not live to see a fair trial. The victim's boyfriend has already beaten him severely, and is waiting to finish the job.

videos.title: The World's a Balloon
videos.overview: An impoverished ventriloquist may lose custody of his orphaned nephew when the boy develops a serious heart condition.

videos.title: Hexed
videos.overview: A staff doctor thinks a patient's baffling symptoms are the result of a voodoo curse.

videos.title: Appointment with Danger
videos.overview: A critically ill scientist is determined to attend an important European conference, despite Gannon's warnings that the trip might kill her.

videos.title: Adults Only
videos.overview: After learning that his wife is a pornographic-movie star, a gifted surgeon wants to leave the hospital.

videos.title: Demi-God
videos.overview: A cancer patient doesn't know whether to believe her faith-healer husband's assurances that he can cure her.

videos.title: The Faces of Peril
videos.overview: A patient refuses to divulge information about herself that might prevent a deadly epidemic.

videos.title: Three-Cornered Cage
videos.overview: A husband anguishes over the responsibility he feels toward his ill wife and the love he feels for her best friend.

videos.title: The Shattered Mask
videos.overview: A mechanic is oddly reluctant to consent to an operation for his wheelchair-bound daughter (Deborah Winters).

videos.title: May God Have Mercy
videos.overview: A former priest (Tim O'Connor) is captivated by a second-rate nightclub singer (Rita Moreno) who faces a dangerous operation.

videos.title: The Prisoners
videos.overview: A convict who agrees to participate in a cancer-research experiment tries to sabotage the project.

videos.title: The Bribe
videos.overview: A socialite (Vera Miles) tries to bribe a handsome tennis pro (Peter Coffield) into romancing her dying daughter (Pamela Franklin).

videos.title: Tainted Lady
videos.overview: Job and social discrimination against cured cancer patients is the theme of this story about a woman (Shirley Knight) who undergoes a mastectomy.

videos.title: Heel of the Tyrant
videos.overview: A Jewish researcher is harassed by young anti-Semites who are led by a hospital orderly (David Macklin).

videos.title: Three on a Tightrope
videos.overview: A heart patient's recovery is endangered when she falls in love with a mentally disabled young man.

videos.title: Midwife
videos.overview: A pregnant young widow (Brooke Bundy), arrested for unlawful midwifery, learns that she has cervical cancer.

videos.title: Kiss and Kill
videos.overview: A conniving young patient (Belinda J. Montgomery) tries to drive a wedge between a wealthy woman (Kim Hunter) and her clinging son (David Soul).

videos.title: Saturday`s Child
videos.overview: An adolescent girl needs surgery, but she won't help Gannon locate her parents so he can get their consent.

videos.title: The Hostile Heart
videos.overview: An orphan's need for open-heart surgery may frighten away prospective parents.

videos.title: No Way Home
videos.overview: A former movie star's will to live is undermined by a failing marriage and ill health.

videos.title: Captives
videos.overview: A pregnant nurse dosen't want to raise a second child without the help of her errant husband.

videos.title: Crown of Thorns
videos.overview: A European princess (Suzy Kendall) escapes her bodyguard and winds up in Gannon's arms.

videos.title: The Invisible Wife
videos.overview: The ailing and neglected wife of a charismatic politician asks Gannon to keep her presence in the hospital a secret.

videos.title: If Mine Eye Offends Me
videos.overview: A convicted child molester will be granted parole only if he takes a drug that might cause impotence.

videos.title: Survivors
videos.overview: Camaraderie turns to rivalry when 12 medical students compete for seven internships.

videos.title: Aftershock
videos.overview: A hospital explosion traps Gannon and five others in the basement.

videos.title: Half a Life
videos.overview: A woman is torn between her desire to live with her lover in Greece, and her duty to her brother, who needs transfusions of her blood.

videos.title: The Fourth Sex (1)
videos.overview: A famed surgeon (Robert Reed) shocks family and colleagues by requesting a sex-change operation. First of two parts.

videos.title: The Fourth Sex (2)
videos.overview: A noted surgeon's request for a sex-change operation is denied.

videos.title: Torment
videos.overview: On his 36th birthday, Gannon is suddenly beset by peculiar emotional and physical symptoms.

videos.title: No Hiding Place
videos.overview: A delirious war veteran accuses a doctor of slaughtering women and children in Vietnam.

videos.title: The Velvet Knife
videos.overview: Gannon's new girlfriend makes impossible demands on his time.

videos.title: Street Girl
videos.overview: A study of teen-age prostitution: the daughter of a successful surgeon takes to the streets in a desperate bid for attention.

videos.title: The Price of a Child
videos.overview: The son of a wealthy Middle Eastern oil magnate upsets Medical Center operations with his "money buys everything" attitude.

videos.title: Too Late for Tomorrow
videos.overview: Learning that he is suffering from a terminal disease, a brilliant surgeon abandons medicine to live out his unfulfilled dreams.

videos.title: The Last Performance
videos.overview: Lochner's former sweetheart (Roberta Peters), a celebrated singer, enters Medical Center suffering from unexplained fainting spells.

videos.title: Two Against Death
videos.overview: An 18-year-old girl needing a critical operation is the key to bringing a doctor's son out of a catatonic state.

videos.title: One Last Rebellion
videos.overview: A young woman confined to a nursing home encourages her elderly fellow inmates to rebel against the home's poor conditions.

videos.title: The Eighth Deadly Sin
videos.overview: An aging surgeon who has begun to make serious mistakes plans to operate on his granddaughter.

videos.title: Gift from a Killer
videos.overview: One of Gannon's patients desperately needs blood, but the only possible donor is a fugitive from justice.

videos.title: The High Cost of Winning
videos.overview: A hospitalized tennis player is attracted to an unhappy girl who is facing heart surgery.

videos.title: The Silent Witness
videos.overview: A lonely nurse stubbornly refuses to press charges against a man who brutally beat her.

videos.title: A Very Private War
videos.overview: Gannon is attracted to a Soviet doctor (Victoria Fedorova) visiting Medical Center on a special assignment.

videos.title: You Can't Annul My Baby
videos.overview: Gannon treats a childlike teenager who's the mother of a baby with a congenital heart defect.

videos.title: Child of Conflict
videos.overview: The adoption of a Vietnamese orphan is complicated when the real mother shows up.

videos.title: The Stranger
videos.overview: The hospitalized victim of a mysterious attacker suffers from a domineering mother and recurring headaches.

videos.title: A Touch of Sight
videos.overview: Gannon treats a young doctor blinded in a shooting accident.

videos.title: Life, Death and Mrs. Armbruster
videos.overview: The mother (Totie Fields) of a dismissed young resident refuses to have a lifesaving operation unless her son is reinstated.

videos.title: Major Annie, M.D.
videos.overview: An Army doctor (Lois Nettleton) searches for answers when her assistant suffers an inexplicable seizure.

videos.title: The Happy State of Depression
videos.overview: A misanthropic con artist and an awkward innocent share an offbeat relationship while being treated at the hospital.

videos.title: If Wishes Were Horses
videos.overview: A much-needed clinic is threatened with closure because the doctors refuse to turn wounded street fighters over to the police.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 4 wins & 8 nominations total
